The '''Jiberah Plains''' were a forested and geographically flat area of land on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It was located south of the [[Yawari Cliffs]], which separated the region from the northern [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Desert of Salma]]. The plains were also bordered by the [[Oniantae Hills]] to the west and the [[Fersal Hills]] to the south.<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of the [[Panshee]] tribe lived in the area.<ref name="SWG:ETV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jiberah Plains were one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
